## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 19.08.2026 - 24.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _C N_, 24.08.2026, 1/5: "i signed up for a trial month, then realized that you put people on automatic subscription and quadruple the monthly cost after first month. i called immediately to cancel. but i just saw on my bank statement that you charged me $44.66 for this month! this has to be illegal!! cancel this immediately and refund my account. i am reporting to my bank! Follow up: THESE PEOPLE ARE CRIMINALS, DO NOT SIGN UP EVER!!! REFUSE TO PROVIDE REFUND FOR FRAUDULENT CHARGES!"
            2. _B “Ilovetacos” R_, 21.08.2026, 4/5: "The app itself is great. It is just too expensive for my budget. When I did have a problem figuring part of it out, Kate Brown in the support area was quick to respond, had everything I needed all in one conversation. No need for multiple back and forths. Overall it's a great app and the workouts are easy to follow, well explained and adaptable."
            3. _Karen Rosenberg_, 21.08.2026, 5/5: "Although this program is expensive, it does help get you moving. However, because of the expense I will not be renewing my subscription. Sorry."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 22.08.2026 - 22.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _C M_, 22.08.2026, 1/5: "DEFINITELY DO NOT RECCOMEND!!! The video ads ALL say it's a "Free" workout app, but "Surprise!" it's not AND they change the $$ amount after the 1st months $10 to $95 after with NO notice, NO refunds and it's almost impossible to cancel!!! Ignore what they say in the advertisements, NOTHING is "Free" in this app except to download it !! (even that might cost you)"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 13.06.2026 - 20.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Clinton Irving_, 20.08.2026, 1/5: "Still waiting for a response regarding the £100 they took out my account early that caused my bank to freeze my account and cost me money due to charges."
            2. _Mel_, 13.06.2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
<!--/ir-theme-->
